name: token-cost
description: See what your Claude Code usage would cost at API prices: live in the status line, and per day, month, session and model with /token-cost.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto, en or nl. auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: auto, usd or eur. auto picks eur for a eurozone system locale, else usd.

eurPerUsd.title: Exchange rate (EUR per USD)
eurPerUsd.description: How many euros one dollar is; used when the currency is eur.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the session's estimated cost in the status line.
